environment.timeout_preflight_warning: options.timeout_s (120s) looks implausible for a tran analysis with ~3.5e+04 timepoints (100p step, 3.5u window) -- even 50 timepoints/s (a generous floor, not a real engine-rate estimate) would need 700s per corner. This is only a coarse, advisory pre-grid heuristic -- it does not block the sweep, and a plausible-looking budget can still turn out to be too short in practice.

job_diagnostic.message: All 45 units hit the time budget (options.timeout_s=120s). The per-unit runtime_s is the timeout, not a measured cost, and the job's elapsed time is far below units x timeout.
